citationText: 9. One reason why higher image harmonics have little practical effect is that the image that appears on the sensor of the electronic camera or scanner is often optically filtered to reduce the amplitude of frequencies above the Nyquist frequency to minimize a form of aliasing that can occur due to frequency components above Nyquist. This form of aliasing is not discussed in this paper. Another reason is that the physical extent of each photosite on the electronic sensor will attenuate higher image frequencies.
